mechanism_claims.claim_text: CLP-19 has direct antibacterial activity in MIC assays against E. coli, S. aureus, and A. baumannii and shows synergistic or partially synergistic FICI values with selected conventional antibiotics.
mechanism_claims.limitations: FICI values are absent where source MICs exceeded test concentrations; those combinations are not inferred.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper associates CLP-19 and CLP-19-based combinations with hydroxyl radical formation and transient NAD+/NADH changes, supporting an oxidative-stress-associated mechanism context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact figure-level numeric values are not tabulated in local XML/PDF text; final curation preserves direction and assay class rather than inventing coordinates.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CLP-19 reduced ceftazidime-associated LPS endotoxin release in the paper's LAL assay context; the direct LPS-neutralization interpretation is tied to this paper plus cited prior CLP-19 work.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: CLP-19 with ceftazidime in Gram-negative bacterial cultures
direct_assay_types: LAL kinetic turbidity endotoxin release assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: This paper supports reduced LPS release; molecular binding/neutralization is not re-quantified here and remains grounded in cited prior work.

nonblocking_material_limitations.impact: Mechanism claims use source-located direction and assay class only; no figure-only exact values were fabricated.
